The dorsal side is dark brown/blackish, while the ventral side and lower flanks are a vibrant reddish-pink. The head is small, rounded, and distinct from the neck but not sharply defined, with a blunt snout. The eye is visible as a small dark spot. The tail tapers to a fine point, though the very tip is out of frame or obscured by the curve.
